correctness.rationale: Dias--Koenig Theorems 5.4 and 5.6 give Gaussian-unitary normal form sqrt(f)|0000>+sqrt(1-f)|1111>, f=F_G in [1/2,1]. Majorana bridge on the total-occupation-four cross sector gauges to 2 times four-cube adjacency. Six zero-eigenvalue Walsh characters have overlap 1/2 with the endpoint sum, so kernel norm=3/2, reject norm=1/2. The diagonal two-copy terms are in the kernel and orthogonal to this cross sector, yielding r=f(1-f)/2. Independently constructed the 8-Majorana 256x256 Jordan--Wigner bridge matrix and spectral projector: zero eigenvalue multiplicity 70 and r values 0, .045, .09375, .125 at f=1,.9,.75,.5; all agree to 1e-15. Since x=1-f<=1/2, x(1-x)/2 is monotone and threshold sharp; independent rounds multiply acceptance probabilities. No mixed-state or higher-mode claim.
